title: ₹900 Ka Gas Cylinder: Gas Agency Owner Ko Kitna Bachta Hai?
description: No scraped reels this week, so this is reasoning. It is the closest cousin to our top petrol pump reel: a regulated product, a fixed commission, and a famously coveted dealership. Audiences who shared the petrol pump reel will want the gas agency version. Prices change, so the reel should be framed as the structure of the split, not a current rate.
text:
**HISAAB FACT SHEET: LPG DISTRIBUTORSHIP (INDIA)**
Checked 3 Nov 2026. Where sources disagree, I say so. Items marked [BLOG] come from agency-advice or aggregator sites, not official sources. Treat them as rough.

**1. HOOK: WHAT YOU PAY**
- 14.2 kg domestic cylinder today: ₹941.50 in Mumbai, ₹942 in Delhi, ₹944.50 in Bangalore, ₹945.50 in Jaipur. [https://www.goodreturns.in/news/gas-cylinder-prices-today-november-3-commercial-lpg-price-costly-at-rs-3117-50-city-wise-lpg-rates-1544807.html]
- Kolkata (July 2026) was ₹968. [https://www.petroldieselprice.com/lpg-gas-cylinder-price-in-Kolkata] Price varies by city.
- The last domestic price revision was 7 June 2026. [https://www.goodreturns.in/news/gas-cylinder-prices-today-november-3-commercial-lpg-price-costly-at-rs-3117-50-city-wise-lpg-rates-1544807.html]
- Delhi was ₹913 before the June hike to ₹942. [https://www.myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com/news/india-hikes-domestic-lpg-prices-again-cylinder-now-costs-rs-942-24-35.html]
- Surprise: the Petroleum Ministry said the cost to supply a 14.2 kg cylinder has risen to around ₹1,600 to ₹1,700. [https://www.india.com/business/domestic-lpg-cylinder-price-hiked-by-rs-29-new-rates-effective-from-today-14-2-kg-lpg-cylinder-in-delhi-cost-rs-942-8438822/]
- PTI sources said state-run oil companies were losing about ₹703 on every cylinder before the June hike. [https://scroll.in/latest/1093402/domestic-lpg-prices-hiked-by-rs-29-for-14-2-kg-cylinders]
- Ujjwala (PMUY) households pay an effective ₹642. [https://www.india.com/business/domestic-lpg-cylinder-price-hiked-by-rs-29-new-rates-effective-from-today-14-2-kg-lpg-cylinder-in-delhi-cost-rs-942-8438822/]

**2. HOW THE PRICE SPLITS**
- Retail price = Market Determined Price + Distributor Commission + GST. [https://factly.in/a-gst-of-5-per-cent-is-levied-on-the-domestic-lpg-cylinders-no-state-imposes-55-per-cent-tax/]
- The Market Determined Price components are listed in PPAC's "Ready Reckoner". [https://factly.in/a-gst-of-5-per-cent-is-levied-on-the-domestic-lpg-cylinders-no-state-imposes-55-per-cent-tax/]
- GST on domestic cylinders is 5% (2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST). [https://factly.in/a-gst-of-5-per-cent-is-levied-on-the-domestic-lpg-cylinders-no-state-imposes-55-per-cent-tax/]
- GST 2.0 left domestic 14.2 kg at 5% and commercial 19 kg at 18%. [https://calcguru.in/how-to-start-an-lpg-gas-agency-in-india/]
- The commission itself is also taxed at 5% GST. [https://www.altnews.in/no-states-do-not-levy-55-tax-on-domestic-lpg-cylinders/]
- Not found: an official 2026 rupee-by-rupee split (product, bottling, freight). Do not invent one on screen.
- Dated structure example (Delhi, Dec 2013, from a PPAC build-up; the line items are the useful part):
  - It showed OMC marketing cost of ₹10.52 and marketing margin of ₹7.03 per cylinder.
  - Distributor commission was ₹40.71 (establishment ₹24.24 + delivery ₹16.47). [https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/view/22293886/price-build-up-of-domestic-subsidized-lpg-142-kg-cylinder-at-delhi]
- Some invoices show the base price and final price, e.g. base ₹871.905, final ₹915.5 (Oct 2021, Indane agency in Karnataka). [https://www.scribd.com/document/552819709/Invoice]

**3. PER-CYLINDER DISTRIBUTOR COMMISSION**
- Commission is fixed by the Petroleum Ministry. It covers pickup from the bottling plant, delivery to the consumer, and costs like salaries, rent, power and phone. [https://www.altnews.in/no-states-do-not-levy-55-tax-on-domestic-lpg-cylinders/]
- Current figure, sources conflict:
  - **₹61.84 per 14.2 kg** is the PPAC figure cited by fact-checkers. A 2026 explainer says it is unchanged since 2019. [https://factly.in/a-gst-of-5-per-cent-is-levied-on-the-domestic-lpg-cylinders-no-state-imposes-55-per-cent-tax/] [https://calcguru.in/how-to-start-an-lpg-gas-agency-in-india/]
  - **₹73.08** is cited by CEEW as the flat commission. It is split into an establishment charge of ₹39.65 and a home delivery charge of ₹33.43. [https://www.ceew.in/publications/how-can-india-improve-clean-cooking-fuel-supply-and-lpg-accessibility]
  - CEEW also notes the fixed commission during its Oct 2022–Mar 2023 survey was ₹64.84, including ₹29.26 for home delivery. [same CEEW URL]
  - Latest news says commission for domestic gas has been unchanged for five years despite rising costs. [https://www.ibtimes.co.in/major-lpg-unions-distance-themselves-strike-seek-commission-relief-through-dialogue-907847]
  - Script suggestion: say "roughly ₹62–₹73, depending on the source" and verify against the PPAC ready reckoner before publishing.
- 5 kg cylinder: ₹36.54 (one news report). [https://www.timesbull.com/business-idea-open-a-gas-agency-and-earn-up-to-rs-70000-per-month-here-is-the-plan/]
- Commission history, which makes a good "frozen" graphic:
  - ₹25.83 before Oct 2012, [https://www.tribuneindia.com/2012/20121006/latest-news.htm]
  - ₹44.06 from Oct 2014 (₹26.06 establishment + ₹18 delivery), [https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=119757]
  - ₹50.58 from Nov 2018, [https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/lpg-prices-hiked-by-over-rs-2-after-govt-raised-dealers-commission-118110900577_1.html]
  - a ₹11.26 hike effective 1 Aug 2019, based on an IIM Ahmed
